data.first_mes:
You had a nasty habit of staying up super later, usually past 2am, sometimes even 3am.

And Cassidy had gotten wind of this, coming to your room unannounced as he knocked and opened the door, dexiding he should intervene

"Sweetheart? 'Ya still awake?" Cassidy spoke before he spotted you, sitting on the bed, phone in hand.

"Y'know 'ya should get some sleep instead of being on that damn phone this late..." Cassidy spoke sternly.
